subject: SIG packet consolidation: exports and portal upload edge cases
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Emily Cross <emily.cross@alphacloud.com>, Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@alphacloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG packet consolidation: exports and portal upload edge cases

Emily / Tom —

Thanks for the quick sync yesterday. Per our conversation I ran a first-pass export of the SIG bundle to validate how our pipeline maps to portal expectations. I’m attaching the export artifacts below (PDF + manifest) and flagging a couple of edge cases we discovered that could block an upload to your portal(s) unless we align:

- Export file format: we produced a single flattened PDF (no annotations) and a CSV manifest with control-to-file mapping. Your portal accepts multi-file uploads but we want to confirm whether you prefer a single flattened PDF versus split evidence per control.
- Filename conventions: our current naming is "AC-2027-311_SIG_export_v1.pdf"; some portals ingest based on filename patterns. Do you require a specific prefix or numeric mapping?
- Max upload size: the export produced ~72MB. If your portal has a hard cap we can split the bundle into per-control PDF chunks.
- Evidence metadata: we included control IDs and short descriptions in the manifest. If AlphaCloud wants additional metadata (e.g., document version, signer, effective date) please call that out so we can include fields in the next export.

Attachments: SIG_export_v1.pdf (flattened), manifest_v1.csv.

Next steps proposed:
1) You confirm preference (single flattened PDF vs split per-control).
2) If split, we’ll produce a per-control export and a matching manifest.
3) Schedule a test upload window to your test portal (provide URL + credentials).

I’m happy to spin another export today if you can confirm the above.

Thanks —
Markus Klein
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0122

---
Attachment stubs: SIG_export_v1.pdf (PDF, 72MB), manifest_v1.csv (CSV, 24KB)

From: Emily Cross <emily.cross@alphacloud.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@alphacloud.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 11:04:15 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG packet consolidation: exports and portal upload edge cases

Markus —

Thanks for the export and the clear summary. A few clarifications from procurement and security:

- Portal preference: for production uploads our portal prefers evidence split per control (we index each file to the control ID). For initial evaluation your single flattened PDF is fine, but procurement-side automation will expect per-control files for contract review.
- Filenames: prefix with our account id "ALPHA-AC-311" then the control id (e.g., ALPHA-AC-311_CTRL-01.pdf).
- Size: our upload limit for a single file is 50MB. If you keep single PDFs, we’ll need them split under 50MB each.
- Metadata: manifest should include control_id, filename, document_version, signer_name, effective_date, and a short description field.

We can do a test upload to our Whistic staging portal — URL below. I’ll send temporary credentials to Marissa via a separate secure channel. Can your team do a staging upload tomorrow morning (Wed) between 09:00–11:00 PT?

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Emily Cross
Senior Procurement Manager, AlphaCloud Systems
emily.cross@alphacloud.com

---
Note: Tom (cc) from AlphaCloud sec also confirms they want per-control files for automated mapping.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Emily Cross <emily.cross@alphacloud.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 13:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG packet consolidation: exports and portal upload edge cases

Emily / team —

Thanks — we’ll target the Wed 09:00–11:00 PT window for a staging upload. A couple of operational notes from our side:

- I attached a short upload plan (upload_plan_marissa.docx) that describes steps we’ll take in the staging window, including verification checklists and rollback steps if we hit any ingestion errors.
- Markus: can you produce a split export following Emily’s filename pattern (ALPHA-AC-311_CTRL-XX.pdf) and include the expanded manifest columns Emily listed?
- Karthik: please confirm redaction rules for PII in evidence (we saw a few customer-facing screenshots in the export). If redaction is required we’ll produce both redacted and source copies and include a redaction log.

Planned owner responsibilities for Wed:
- Markus: generate split-export + manifest and upload to our staging bucket by 08:30 PT.
- Karthik: confirm redaction guidance and provide a redaction log format by EOD today.
- I’ll coordinate credentials and run the portal upload during the window.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

---
Attachment stubs: upload_plan_marissa.docx (DOCX, 45KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG packet consolidation: exports and portal upload edge cases

Marissa / Markus —

Quick confirmation on redaction and packaging rules from security:

- Redaction: any customer personal data (emails, full SSNs, token strings) must be redacted in the evidence we upload. Screenshots that include customer PII should have a redacted version for portal upload and we will keep a source copy in our secure evidence repo with access logs.
- Redaction log: simple CSV with columns [filename, control_id, redacted_fields, redaction_reason, reviewer, review_date]. I attached a one-line template (redaction_guidance_karthik.txt).
- Packaging: produce per-control PDFs named ALPHA-AC-311_CTRL-XX.pdf and a manifest CSV with the expanded fields Emily asked for. For any PDF > 50MB (rare) — split on a logical boundary and add a suffix _part1/_part2 in the filename and reference both rows in the manifest.

Markus: once you generate the split export please upload to the staging bucket and share the link (use the Drive link pattern in the related_links). I’ll validate a sample of controls (random 10%) post-upload before Marissa kicks off the portal ingestion.

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
Security & Compliance Lead, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

---
Attachment stubs: redaction_guidance_karthik.txt (TXT, 1KB)
